vision.concept: A relationship told through the small things left behind in one shared room.
vision.narrativeOverview: PROPOSED: The lead performer moves through an empty loft after a breakup. Each chorus reveals a different memory staged in the same room. The final chorus returns to the present and ends with the performer choosing what to keep. No dialogue or additional location is required.
vision.notes: Illustrative example only. All cast, wardrobe, props, location and schedule details below are proposals, not bookings or confirmed arrangements.

scenes.title: The Empty Room
scenes.description: PROPOSED: A wide, still frame introduces the lead alone in the shared loft. They notice a small stack of photographs and begin the first verse.

shots.description: Locked wide master with the performer entering frame
Close detail of the photographs on the table

scenes.title: Memory in the Chorus
scenes.description: PROPOSED: The second presence is suggested by an empty chair, a second cup, and eyeline matches. Keep the other person off camera to avoid adding cast unless later approved.

shots.description: Medium performance take across the table
Slow move toward the empty chair on the last chorus line

scenes.title: Choosing What Remains
scenes.description: PROPOSED: At the bridge, the performer sorts the photographs, keeps one, and leaves the room in a calm final wide shot. Reuse the same light and set dressing.

shots.description: Hands keep one photograph and place the rest in a box
Final locked wide with the performer leaving frame
